ex.en: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我看過的最差勁的電影了。

ex.en: My father took me to a movie last night.
ex.zh: 我爸爸昨晚帶我去看電影。

ex.en: She used to go to the movies on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她以前星期天都會去看電影。

ex.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們終於到達了山頂。

ex.en: The mountain is not as high as Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 這座山沒有富士山高。

ex.en: My younger brother really likes to take photos of mountains.
ex.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡拍山的照片。

ex.en: I have a mountain of work to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一大堆工作要做。

ex.en: There's a mountain of laundry on the bed.
ex.zh: 床上堆了一大堆要洗的衣服。

ex.en: When you're done sweeping, I'll mop.
ex.zh: 你掃完地之後，我來拖地。

ex.en: Tom mopped the floor.
ex.zh: 湯姆拖了地。

ex.en: The mop is in the closet next to the bathroom.
ex.zh: 拖把在浴室旁邊的櫃子裡。

ex.en: Wring out the mop before you use it.
ex.zh: 用之前先把拖把擰乾。

ex.en: We took out a 30-year mortgage to buy our home.
ex.zh: 我們申請了三十年的房貸買房子。

ex.en: Most of my salary goes to the mortgage.
ex.zh: 我大部分的薪水都拿去付房貸。

ex.en: He compared his car to the new model.
ex.zh: 他拿自己的車和新款比較。

ex.en: This is the latest model of the phone.
ex.zh: 這是這支手機的最新型號。

ex.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
ex.zh: 邁克從早餐後就一直在做模型飛機。

ex.en: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
ex.zh: 所有的模型都是錯的，但有些是有用的。

ex.en: She is said to have been a model.
ex.zh: 據說她以前當過模特兒。

ex.en: The model walked down the runway.
ex.zh: 模特兒走上伸展台。

ex.en: A monument was built to honor the soldiers.
ex.zh: 人們建了一座紀念碑來紀念那些士兵。

ex.en: The old temple is a national monument.
ex.zh: 那座古廟是國定古蹟。
